title: Understand-Anything Knowledge Graph
description: Per-repo structural knowledge graph produced by /understand-scan. Captures files, symbols, dependencies, and layer assignments with LLM-authored summaries.

graph_schema_version.description: Schema version. Bump on any breaking change to this document. Consumers MUST check this and degrade gracefully on mismatch.

commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA the scan was performed against. Short (7) or full (40) hex.

scanned_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the scan completed.

file_hashes.description: Map of repo-relative file path to sha256:HEX hash. Drives incremental rescans.

scan_cost_usd.description: Total LLM cost in USD for this scan (sum across all subagents).

project_knowledge_sha.description: sha256 of PROJECT-KNOWLEDGE.md at scan time, or null if absent.

layers.description: Named architectural layers (e.g., api, service, data). Used for grouping and coloring in viewer.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by node.layer. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, underscores.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the viewer.

color.description: Hex color used for layer in the viewer (e.g., #3366cc).

nodes.description: Graph nodes: files, modules, and symbols within them.

id.description: Stable unique identifier. Convention: '<path>' for files, '<path>::<symbol>' for symbols. Used as the from/to value in edges.

kind.description: What this node represents in source. 'file' and 'module' are container kinds; the rest are symbols.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the source file.

name.description: Display name (basename for files, identifier for symbols).

layer.description: Layer id from the top-level layers array, or null/absent if unclassified.

summary.description: LLM-authored plain-English summary of what this node does. Uses PROJECT-KNOWLEDGE.md vocabulary when applicable.

hash.description: sha256:HEX of the source extent that produced this summary. Enables incremental rescan.

tags.description: Optional freeform tags (e.g., entry-point, deprecated, generated).

line_start.description: 1-based start line in the source file (for symbol nodes).

line_end.description: 1-based end line in the source file (for symbol nodes).

edges.description: Directed edges between nodes. The 'from' and 'to' values must be node ids.

kind.description: Relationship type. 'contains' is used for file→symbol parent edges; the rest are inter-symbol relationships.
